subject: Confirming evaluation kickoff & prioritizing use-cases
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>
To: Alicia Cortez <alicia@brightpath.health>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 09 Apr 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Follow-up: discovery recap & suggested kickoff windows

Hi Alicia — thanks again for a productive discovery this morning. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we can lock in an evaluation kickoff:

- Goals you shared: reduce triage time for inbound referrals, surface high-confidence recommendations, and measure false-positive rate below 6% in triage rules.
- Success criteria we should validate during the trial: end-to-end latency under 300ms p90 for in-app calls, model precision/recall targets tied to the provided prompt set, and integration stability for 1000 daily users.

To align calendars, can you confirm which of these kickoff windows works for your team?
  • Tue Apr 16 — 10:00–11:00 PT (recommended: intro + config + success-metrics worksheet)
  • Wed Apr 17 — 13:00–14:00 PT (tech deep-dive + prompt-run examples)

I've attached a trial success metrics template and a short proposed agenda. For the tech deep-dive we typically ask for a BrightPath technical lead (networking/ops) and a product owner to join. If you prefer, we can split the kickoff into two 45-min sessions (business + technical).

Pre-kickoff ask: please share a representative prompt pack (5–10 prompts) and any data retention/security constraints so we can prepare the right environment. You can upload to the Drive link below or reply with attachments.

Attachments: redwood-trial-success-metrics-template.xlsx (xlsx), proposed-kickoff-agenda.pdf (pdf)

Thanks — I can be flexible on time if none of the slots fit.

Ben
Ben Carter | Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
ben@redwood.ai | (415) 555-0123

On a related note: Marissa will run the onboarding checklist and Karthik will own the tech validation during the trial.

From: Alicia Cortez <alicia@brightpath.health>
To: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>
Cc: BrightPath Health Technical Lead <tl@brightpath.health>
Date: Mon, 09 Apr 2028 12:39:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Follow-up: discovery recap & suggested kickoff windows

Thanks, Ben — appreciate the clear recap. Wed Apr 17 13:00–14:00 PT works best for our team (product + one engineer). A couple of notes from our side:

- Security/compliance: we have a short questionnaire (SOC2 scope + data flow diagram) that our security team will want to review before we send any production-like data. Is there a standard redwood SOC2 summary or evidence bundle you can share?
- Prompt pack: I can get you 8 representative prompts plus sample outputs by EOD Tue Apr 10. We prefer the tech deep-dive to include your Karthik and an engineer who can speak to KV caching and latency tuning.
- Success metric tweak: can we add a business KPI to the template — % reduction in manual triage time (baseline is ~18 minutes per referral)? That will help our product team quantify impact.

If Wed 4/17 is locked, can you send a calendar invite with dial-in and an initial agenda? Also loop in anyone who will demo the RBAC/KMS integrations.

Alicia
Alicia Cortez
Director of Product, BrightPath Health
alicia@brightpath.health | +1-617-555-8899

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, Alicia Cortez <alicia@brightpath.health>
Date: Tue, 10 Apr 2028 08:21:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Follow-up: discovery recap & suggested kickoff windows

Thanks — locking Wed 4/17 13:00 PT for the tech deep-dive. Quick operational checklist from my side so we hit the ground running:

1) Pre-kickoff deliverables (please send by EOD Tue 4/10):
   - Prompt pack (8 examples) + expected labels/annotations
   - Sample payload size and typical sequence lengths (tokens)

2) Pre-config: we'll spin a dedicated eval instance with the model variants you requested. To validate latency at the start we need one synthetic trace from your stack (curl or Postman example).

3) Security: Ben, can you attach the standard SOC2 summary and a short note on data isolation for dedicated evals? Alicia — if your security team needs an exec-level contact, loop me in and I'll introduce our compliance lead.

4) Agenda items to prioritize: onboarding + prompt mapping (20 mins), infra/resilience and KMS (20 mins), success metrics + reporting cadence (15 mins), next steps (5 mins). If Alicia prefers a split session, happy to reformat.

I'll send a calendar invite once Ben confirms attachments and final attendee list.

—Karthik
Karthik Iyer | Staff Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference

From: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>
To: Alicia Cortez <alicia@brightpath.health>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 11 Apr 2028 15:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Confirmed: Wed Apr 17 13:00 PT — kickoff agenda + prework

Perfect — Wed 4/17 13:00–14:00 PT is confirmed. Calendar invite sent (Zoom link + conference pin). Final notes and attachments below:

- Attached: redwood-trial-success-metrics-template.xlsx (contains a KPI row for "% reduction in manual triage time" as requested) and proposed-kickoff-agenda.pdf (agenda reflects the prioritized items Karthik listed).
- Security docs: redwood-soc2-summary.pdf (sent privately to Alicia's security lead via secure link) — Alicia, I shared a short evidence bundle link in the HubSpot ticket (see related links).
- Prework for BrightPath: please upload the prompt pack and a sample request/response trace to the Drive link by EOD Tue 4/10. If you prefer to share via SFTP, let me know and I'll open a transfer request.

Next steps after kickoff: 1) finalize trial environment config, 2) run the seed prompt set and record baseline metrics, 3) two-week iterative tuning cadence with weekly metric checkpoints. We'll also add a success-report template to the Drive folder after the first run.

If anything changes on your side, ping me and we can move the slot — otherwise see you on 4/17.

Ben
Ben Carter | Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
Attachments: redwood-trial-success-metrics-template.xlsx, proposed-kickoff-agenda.pdf
